APPROVE
The split keeps the same checks: the expression branch's inverted guard is logically equivalent, the added `k > 0` in `IsPayloadCall` always holds there because `k` starts at `body.Start + 1`, and the merged `&&` conditions short-circuit in the original order, leaving `AnswersOnlyConstants` with only a ternary or two. I couldn't build it because the source isn't on this machine, so the `Lexed` parameter type is assumed from the diff.
